== Biography ==
John was born in 14 Janaury 1839 and christened 14 February, 1839 in New Monkland, Scotland.  He is the son of [[Glasgow-424|John Glasgow]] and [[Forsyth-878|Christina Forsyth]].<ref>"Church of Scotland: Old Parish Registers - Births and Baptisms," database, National Records of Scotland, ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ ScotlandsPeople] : accessed 6 December 2025), John Glasgow born or baptised on 10 Feb 1839, son of John Glasgow & Christian Forsyth, in Airdrie or New Monkland, Scotland; citing Parish Number: 651; Ref: 60/266; Frame: 1479.</ref> ''The transcription found on Familysearch is not correct. It shows birth after christening. ''<ref>'''Baptism''': "Scotland Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950," database<br/>{{FamilySearch Record|XTGM-XZZ}} (accessed 21 April 2023)<br/>John Glasgow baptism on 10 Feb 1839 (born 14 Feb 1839), son of John Glasgow & Christian Forsyth, in New Monkland, Lanarkshire, Scotland, United Kingdom.</ref>

It is assume that John died before 1844 since another child was given the same name.
